steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Arrggghhh! Didn't I tell you not to bother me today?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Who's—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: ...Sister.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What are you doing here...?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Don't just stand there, take a seat. What's the matter, can't sleep?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I thought I told Yucatan to keep a close eye on you—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: No...
She shakes her head.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I told Yucatan not to come with me.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I wanted to talk to you, one-on-one.
Ratatos never thought she would see this expression on her sister, who is usually so cheerful and straightforward.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Alright. But only for a little bit. Then you go back to bed.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: *sigh* Acting like a little girl, when you're supposed to be a mom already.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I heard Arctosz shouting in the drawing room today.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Damn, so he did disturb you?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'll have his hairy head for this.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: No, it's not that...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I heard what you were arguing about, and I know many bad things have been happening lately...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Please, Rata... if you do know something, tell me.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: By Kjeragandr...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You shouldn't be worrying about these things right now, Sciurus.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You'll have plenty to worry about once you take my job.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But there's been trouble after trouble. Even I, shut up in my room, can tell that things are getting worse...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I see unhappy faces outside the window every day, not to mention we haven't heard anything back from Monch.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I have people searching for her... I'm sure she's fine. Hey, don't forget that she's one of the finest Browntail warriors!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I know...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: It's you I'm really worried about, Rata.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I've never helped very much, but there was a time when I could at least stand by your side and give you my support...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But now, you're facing all this on your own... I wish you would talk to me more.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: There's no need to carry everything on your shoulders. Yucatan and I have your back, no matter what.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You think too much, my silly little sister. Are you really in such a hurry to take over for me?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: That's not what I—

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I promise you, Sciurus.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'll protect you, and Yucatan, and all of Clan Browntail.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If it's the last thing I do.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Kjeragandr be my witness.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Still don't believe me? But you've got to believe Kjeragandr, right?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: There's no need to go that far...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Alright... then promise me you're going to bed now.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Tomorrow will be a better day.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: You honor me with your invitation, Madam Browntail.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: I take it your thinking has changed, then?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: ...Cut the crap.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Assassinating the members of Clan Silverash and Clan Paleroche, driving a rift between the three clans... is this how you intend to coerce me into working with you?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I thought Victorian politicians were smarter than that.
The man smiles nonchalantly.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: I'm not sure how such a notion could have occurred to you, Madam Browntail.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Assassinating the leadership of another country on their own soil... it would be tantamount to a declaration of war... if it could be proven.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Are you sure you want to accuse Victoria of such crimes?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So this is why you people seem so smug about yourselves.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: I'm not sure I understand your meaning.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: But since you've deigned to meet with me today, I am very happy to listen—is there anything I can help you with?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Go on, act smug. Your crude little plot worked, huh? The relationship between the Paleroches and Browntails has broken down completely, and I've become the most suspicious one here.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: As for Enciodes... he just spun his tale about all three clans wanting stability to hoodwink that fool Arctosz.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: He knows full well that, in the present state of Kjerag, should the leader of any of the clans meet an 'accident', it would take little effort to demoralize the already-disheartened people.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If he learns of our meeting, he will not hesitate to join forces with the Paleroches to attack me, even if he knows full well I wouldn't promise you anything.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: After all, what Kjerag needs right now is a culprit, one to place all the blame on.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: In that event, it's entirely possible that Clan Browntail will be wiped off the map.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: ...I don't have much time left.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: My sympathies, madam. I am in full agreement with your assessment of the situation.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Do you intend to turn things around, then?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Let's get straight to the point.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: First, I want an absolute guarantee that you will prioritize the safety of Clan Browntail and the people of my domain, no matter what happens.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Of course. We have long sympathized with the ordinary folk who have become marginalized by Clan Silverash. It is one of our major goals for peaceful cooperation with Kjerag.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Ugh... say whatever you want.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Second, all the trade policies currently in place will remain so when Clan Browntail takes over from Karlan Trade, and Victoria must not withdraw any assistance currently offered to Kjerag.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Otherwise, we reserve the right to terminate our cooperation with immediate effect—not something you want to happen.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: You need not worry, madam. We are more than eager to cooperate with Kjerag, and would never dream of undermining this partnership.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: There will be much room for further cooperation, once you become the sole representative of your nation.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Good...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Taking over Karlan Trade isn't something that can be accomplished overnight. We need time to prepare... and the first order of business is to deal with Arctosz.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I know that man, and he will come looking for trouble if he finds out Clan Browntail has been working with Victoria.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: In a sense, he is an even bigger problem than Enciodes...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That bloody fool!

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Most regrettable...

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: The decision is yours, Madam Browntail. How should we... persuade Arctosz?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I will contact him again... for one final meeting.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: There is an old Browntail manor at the foot of the mountains in the southwest, an area that is virtually uninhabited.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I will send Arctosz a message, telling him to meet me there tomorrow, where I will explain the truth.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The time of the meeting is set at 7pm... fifteen hours from now.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I hope Victoria will demonstrate its good faith.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Of course. You will not be disappointed.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: We look forward to your 'persuasion' of Clan Paleroche.
The mountain wind carries the snow, battering the hay-thatched roof.
A few dry leaves are blown into the air, landing on the braids of the girl sitting on the rooftop. She picks it out and rubs it in her fingers.
The Rift Cloudbeast pokes its head out from behind the girl's shoulders, rubbing against her red cheeks.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Rift Cloudbeast...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I'm just... clearing my head. You don't have to come out and be cold with me together.
The little white creature, which has endured many harsh days and nights with Joanna, purrs gently.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I... I don't know how to face the Saintess...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: She's the vicar of Kjeragandr. I should love and honor her, but—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: How could those things happen... Why must my family be punished...?
The girl sits quietly on the roof, Rift Cloudbeast in her arms, until the fine snowflakes cover her hair in white.
The door leading to the backyard is pushed open.
The visitor has added a few shallow footprints on the snow. Enya sees three scattered crossbows as she walks to her left, and picks up one to examine it.
It is smaller than the one that Joanna uses.
Enya casts her gaze in front, and there are three targets standing a short distance away, with a few bolts on them that have yet to be retrieved.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: They started training at such a young age...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: There is a name on the stock... does it belong to her siblings?
Enya's attention is drawn to a bunch of sculptures scattered haphazardly on the ground at the other end of the yard. Their visage is a familiar one.
Enya approaches the largest amongst them and holds it before her. The sculptor was obviously extremely skilled—Kjeragandr is smiling gently upon her.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: just like the one we built at Lake Silberneherze.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I guess this is what they all think you look like.
There are other sculptures lying by her feet, and Enya picks up one of them.
This one is sleeker, the chisel marks on the face rougher, giving it a sense of harshness. Perhaps the sculptor had used too much force when sculpting the face, and chiseled off a little too much.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It's not right, is it? Doesn't look like Kjeragandr at all.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The face needs to be a little thinner, and the body...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Will you heed the plea of your humble handmaiden, Saintess?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Enya, pleeease—

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: See? It looks better when the face is rounder.
She carefully puts the two sculptures of different sizes back.
In this bare, unfamiliar backyard, Enya puts her hands together and prays toward the statue of Kjeragandr, as the elders of Vine-Bead Court often do.
She does not make any wish. She only hopes for a miracle.
The sun has set, but the huntress still sits in the yard.
She hurriedly gets up to bow when she sees Enya, but the latter lays a hand on her shoulder.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: ...Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No need for formalities. It's just us two.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I would prefer it if you could call me 'Enya'.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: As you wish.
After greeting Enya, the girl looks aside and falls quiet again.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: There were a lot of Kjeragandr sculptures in the backyard. Did you and your family make them yourselves?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: (Nods in silence)

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: They look a little different. Is it because people interpret the image of Kjeragandr depicted in the old books differently?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: My dad made the ones that looked like Her. I made the ones that don't...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Pfft—

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I'm sorry! I just wanted to ask... why did you make all those sculptures?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: My family is a branch of Clan Paleroche that went into the mountains on Kjeragandr's orders. We've been hunters ever since.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: We believe all that lives in the mountains share Kjeragandr's soul, and we are all part of the eternal cycle of life within Her.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: In gratitude for the blessings of Kjeragandr, every member of our family must learn to sculpt the image of Kjeragandr once we are old enough to hunt alone.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: We also make leather jackets, bone sculptures and accessories with Her mark.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'Hear, blessed hunter.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'Are the whispers of the wind and the grass not Her hymns? Are the creatures that walk and fly not She embodied?'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'The cycle of life and death is the cycle of water and ice; there is neither beginning nor end.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'Speak of Kjeragandr's wisdom and love, and listen.'

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: 'Rely not on signs and omens, but seek upon snow-covered peaks'... and then... and then—

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'And become one with Her.'

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Yes... this part feels different from the other parts of Kjeragandr. I always get stuck here.

spans.text: Yes... this part feels different from the other parts of

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The details of the scriptures are not what matters the most. What's important is to be constantly mindful that Kjeragandr watches and listens to our words and deeds.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You may not remember the complicated verses, but you're living, hunting, and sculpting in accordance with Her teachings.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Even as the Saintess... I may never have truly understood the meaning of this passage, if I hadn't met you.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You're one of the most pious faithful I've ever met. Kjeragandr will protect your family.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Yes. I'm Her... chosen Saintess, after all. She will appear when we need her most, no matter what hardship we face.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: *sob*—
Tears roll down the young cheeks of the huntress who always puts on a strong front, falling and melting the snow by their feet.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Joanna? What's the matter? Can you tell me?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I, I—
Enya takes Joanna's trembling hands in hers.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: When I first learned to hunt, I was bitten by an Infected beast... and I got Oripathy...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Dad hunted every day and made those sculptures after coming back from the hunt, so that he could sell them in town to buy medicine for me... and he did it for years...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: A few days ago, dad's friend told me... he was at the station... the day the Catastrophe happened...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: If I didn't—

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Joanna...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Why, Kjeragandr...?
The grieving girl drops to the ground, curled up in a fetal position.
Enya kneels by her side, trying to find words of consolation, but for all the scriptures she has memorized, none have an answer. After a brief hesitation, she begins patting the girl's back.
There is a lump in her throat. If even eternal Kjeragandr can fall silent, what could Her Saintess possibly do?
Are you listening, Kjarr...?
Sitting by the window, the Rift Cloudbeast suddenly growls with as much volume as it can muster, and darts back into Joanna's hood.
Joanna sniffles and wipes her tears with her palms.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Someone's coming. I'll get the door.

steps.name: Passing Old Man
steps.text: Young lady...

steps.name: Passing Old Man
steps.text: How do I get to the nearest town?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Are you lost? Do you see those lights? Follow the trail down the mountain, and follow the lights whenever you come to a crossroads—

steps.name: Passing Old Man
steps.text: It's getting dark... and my eyesight is poor...

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: I'll walk with you—

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: No... I can't leave right now.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: You could spend the night here, and head down once the sun rises.

steps.name: Passing Old Man
steps.text: No, no, I shouldn't trouble you. I'll find the path down the mountain...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Just an old man who got lost.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You're quite far from town. Do people pass by here often?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: No. My family are the only ones who live here. We don't see many passersby. In fact, you were the first...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: —Look out!
